build_Receiver: build a Receiver neural network module with configurable hidden layers and output dimensions
create_IdentitySender: create an IdentitySender module that passes input messages through unchanged with offset
create_RotatedSender: create a RotatedSender module that encodes sum and difference of input attributes
create_Lenses: create a Lenses module that rotates input examples using a configurable theta angle
create_CircleSender: create a CircleSender module that maps continuous values in [-1,1] to discrete vocabulary tokens
